title: Space CRM tasks live in the one task table beside Plan to-dos

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-24: Space CRM tasks are crm_activities rows with kind='task' while Plan to-dos and the operator queue use crm_tasks, so a person's work is split across two tables and no list shows both. crew_tasks stays separate on purpose (the member volunteer economy). Fix: move the rows into crm_tasks (additive migration), point space-tasks.ts at it.

UPDATED 2026-11-25 (Plans and calendar clarity audit): production holds 0 crm_activities rows with kind='task', so no data moves. The fix is only to point lib/crm/space-tasks.ts and the Space CRM Tasks panel at crm_tasks (contact_id / deal_id), so a Space has one to-do list.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
